examples.title: Load an image sequence and set its frame range
examples.code:
# Create a Read node for an image sequence.
read = nuke.createNode("Read")
read["file"].setValue("D:/renders/shot.####.exr")
read["first"].setValue(1001)
read["last"].setValue(1100)

# Update the frame range later without recreating the node.
read["first"].setValue(1010)
read["last"].setValue(1080)
